prek_hooks.name: 🗄️ claude-all · Assertive SQL (no silent ON CONFLICT / IF EXISTS / CASCADE)
prek_hooks.description: Flags tolerant SQL (targeted ON CONFLICT, IF [NOT] EXISTS, DROP ... CASCADE, swallowed IntegrityError) lacking an allowlist entry with a reason, and bans target-less ON CONFLICT outright.

prek_hooks.name: 🗄️ claude-all · INSERT INTO names its columns
prek_hooks.description: Flags INSERT INTO t VALUES (...) statements in Python string/f-string literals that have no explicit column list.
